fixtures.name: month_end

fixtures.name: binary_search

fixtures.name: interval_merge
fixtures.final: Fixed `IntervalMerge.merge/1`: the original assumed sorted input and used `<'` instead of `<=` for merging. The corrected version sorts intervals first and merges overlapping/touching intervals (`start <= cur_stop`), handling any-order input correctly.

fixtures.name: rate_limiter
fixtures.final: Fixed the check-then-act race by making the count check and increment a single atomic `Agent.get_and_update`, so the cap holds exactly under concurrent admission.

fixtures.name: safe_echo
fixtures.final: Fixed the shell-injection vulnerability in `SafeEcho.run/1` by replacing `System.shell` with `System.cmd("echo", [input])`, which passes the input as a literal argument instead of interpolating it into a shell command.

fixtures.name: lru_cache
fixtures.final:
The fix works: after fetching `:a` (a hit), `:a` moves to the front of `order`, so the subsequent `put(:c)` evicts the now-LRU `:b` rather than `:a`.

Fixed: `get` on a hit now refreshes the key's recency (moves it to the front of `order`) so the LRU eviction order is correctly maintained.

fixtures.name: percentile
fixtures.final: Fixed the percentile calculation to use linear interpolation between closest ranks (rank = p/100*(n-1)) as documented, instead of the buggy truncating index lookup, and verified the `[1,2,3,4], 50 == 2.5` example holds.
